{{Top|leg}}
The '''Conclave of Worms''' was a meeting of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The first Conclave took place prior to the [[Xim Wars]] and at it, [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] was made [[Clan-General]] of the Hutts.
